 It also marks a connection with the related *Yasodharāpamukhaaṭṭhārasabhikkhunīsahassaapadāna* (Thi-Ap 30).

Automated analysis by DharmaNexus corroborates this relationship, registering 169 Pali text-reuse matches across 24 texts, with Thi-Ap 30 being the largest match partner (17 matches, including an extended alignment from §29.2–51.2 to §17.2–39.2) [DharmaNexus]. Outside Pali, DharmaNexus identifies machine alignments with the Sanskrit *Saṃghāṭasūtra*, the *Carmavastu*, and a Tibetan Kangyur text [DharmaNexus].
